skipped: Subway Club: not on the current Australian menu or nutrition guide (May 2026)
Roast Chicken: not listed under that name; the current equivalent is Rotisserie-Style Chicken, which is included
Steak & Cheese: not listed under that name; the current steak subs are Philly-Style Three-Cheese Steak and Chipotle Steak Melt, both included
Meatball Melt: not listed under that name; the current equivalent is Italian Meatball, which is included
Plain Turkey and plain Veggie Delite 6 inch subs: only published as Turkey on Rye and Veggie Delite with Avo, which are included
Footlong subs: not published as separate rows; the guide only says to double the 6 inch values for an approximate footlong, so no footlong items were recorded

Salads (regular and large): the PDF's salad tables could not be read reliably (two blocks of values with unclear headings), so none were recorded rather than risk assigning large-salad numbers to regular salads
Large flour wraps: published in the same guide but left out to keep scope to the common items; can be added from the same PDF if wanted
Mini subs, breakfast items, sides, smoothies: out of scope for this pass
notes: All values are per serve from Subway Australia's official 'AUS Nutritional Web Guide May 2026' PDF (subway.com, Australia media folder). Australia has no single standard build: each 6 inch sub is published with its own bread (white, wheat, malted rye or Italian Herbs & Cheese), cheese, salad and sauce, and the item names here record that exact build. Wraps are the same fillings on a regular flour wrap. kcal values are as published in the guide. The PDF could not be downloaded directly in this session (proxy blocked subway.com), so values were read via WebFetch and the 6 inch sub rows were cross-checked across two separate reads with identical results; a spot check against the PDF before import is still worthwhile. The guide marks Seafood Sensation and Tuna Mayo with '(I)'; the meaning of that marker was not confirmed.
